summary: Iteration 5 (Monetization: RevenueCat coin packs + generic upgrades + Serving Plates + Bigger Holding Area). Backend: 40/40 pytest tests green — 23 prior regression tests + 17 new iter-5 tests across 5 new classes (TestCoinPacks, TestUpgradesInfo, TestGenericUpgrade parametrized over grill/pantry/plates/holding, TestHoldingAreaPantryCap, TestRevenueCatWebhook, TestPlayerDefaultsIter5). Confirmed: (a) GET /api/coin-packs returns 3 packs coins_500/1200/3000 with fallback_price, best_value=true on coins_3000; (b) GET /api/upgrades-info/{pid} returns all 4 upgrades with correct bases (grill 150, pantry 120, plates 100, holding 130), each max_level=3, plus coins; 404 for unknown player; (c) POST /api/players/{pid}/upgrade/{key} progresses 0→3 for every key with cost scaling base*(level+1), rejects with 400 on insufficient coins and 400 when maxed (4th tap), 404 for unknown key and unknown player, and decrements coins + increments the correct field (grill_level/pantry_level/plates_level/holding_level); (d) holding-area pantry cap = pantry_level + holding_level*2 verified end-to-end via /api/pantry-info + /api/save-pantry (pantry=1+holding=1 caps at 3; pantry=2+holding=2 caps at 6); (e) POST /api/revenuecat/webhook grants coins for NON_RENEWING_PURCHASE (verified all 3 products: 500/1200/3000 all correctly increment coins), duplicate transaction_id returns {ok:true, duplicate:true} without re-granting, unknown product_id returns 400, non-purchase event types return {ok:true, ignored:...}; (f) new-player defaults now include plates_level=0 and holding_level=0 with no _id leaks. Frontend (mobile 390x844): (1) /coin-store renders 3 pack cards (pack-coins_500/1200/3000) with fallback prices $0.99/$2.99/$4.99, iap-notice banner explaining publish-required, BEST VALUE badge on coins_3000, and free-earn hint '💡 You can also earn coins free by playing levels & Rush!'; tapping buy-pack-coins_500 shows coin-toast 'Purchases activate after you publish a build' as expected since RevenueCat is web-unavailable; (2) /shop renders all 4 upgrade-card-* (grill/plates/pantry/holding) each with upgrade-btn-* + level dots + descriptive text, plus get-coins-button in header and buy-coins-banner both routing to /coin-store; regression boosters shop-item-*/buy-* (extra_moves/hint/coin_doubler/hammer/shuffle) all render; upgrading plates (Lv 0/3 → Lv 1/3, cost changes 100→200) and holding (Lv 0/3 → Lv 1/3, cost 130→260) via UI persists server-side (verified via GET /api/players/{pid}: plates_level=1, holding_level=1, coins=600-100-130=370); (3) home coin-balance chip is tappable and navigates to /coin-store. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none. RN-web shadow*/textShadow* deprecation warnings on web are still emitted and are explicitly OK-to-ignore per review_request.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py UPGRADES map is a nice consolidation — single source of truth for max/base/field. However the old /players/{id}/upgrade-grill and /upgrade-pantry endpoints are now redundant with /upgrade/{key} — consider deprecating them in a future iteration to avoid drift (both currently correct, but if base costs ever change they would need to be edited in two places).

server.py revenuecat/webhook is idempotent by inserting the transaction row BEFORE the $inc — good ordering. One tiny concern: if db.players.update_one({'id': player_id}, ...) does not match (e.g. bogus app_user_id from the store), the transaction row is still stored and no coins are granted; the webhook still returns {ok:true, granted:1200}. Consider checking update_result.matched_count and reporting an error / cleaning up the rc_purchases row, else players who mis-register with the store could be silently lost.

server.py revenuecat/webhook: REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_AUTH is currently empty in .env, so the endpoint accepts unauthenticated calls — expected for preview per review_request. Before shipping, this MUST be set to a strong random value in the production .env.

server.py pantry_capacity returns pantry_level + holding_level*2 — meaning at holding_level=0 & pantry_level=0 the cap is 0 (nothing stores). At pantry_level=3 & holding_level=3 the cap is 9. Matches the request description ('expands beyond level 3').
server.py upgrade_generic returns player_public(doc) — same shape as other endpoints, no _id leak.
frontend/app/coin-store.tsx iapReady = purchasesAvailable() && Platform.OS !== 'web'. On web this is always false, so buy always shows the preview toast — matches spec.
frontend/app/shop.tsx doUpgrade guards on maxed and next_cost==null and coin balance; showsToast('Not enough coins!') — good UX.
frontend/app/index.tsx coin-balance is now a Pressable that routes to /coin-store — confirmed via testID and tap.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (home coin-balance nav, coin-store 3 packs + iap-notice + BEST VALUE + buy toast, shop 4 upgrade cards + buttons + banner + booster regression, upgrade progression persists server-side, buy-coins-banner nav)

seed_data_creation: Pytest created disposable TEST_* players. Playwright created TEST_UI_I5_* players with 600 coins to exercise plates + holding upgrades. No cleanup endpoint — safe.
